chapterInfo.content:
7
Onyankopɔn bu atɛntenenee
Dawid adesrɛ dwom a Benyaminni Kus nsɛm nti ɔto maa AWURADE.
1 # 1 Sa 24.10; 26.19; 2 Sa 16.5-11 AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn, wo na medwane bɛtoa wo.
Gye me m’atifoɔ nyinaa nsam, na yi me!
2 # Dwom 10.8-9 Na wɔansunsuane me kra sɛ gyata antete me mu
a ɔgyefoɔ nni hɔ.
3 # Hiob 31.7-34 AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, sɛ mayɛ yei,
na amumuyɛdeɛ bi wɔ me nsam,
4sɛ mayɛ deɛ ɔne me te asomdwoeɛ mu bɔne
na madi deɛ ɔha me no amim bi kwa a,
5ma ɔtamfoɔ ntaa me kra,
na ɔnkyere me, na ɔntiatia me nkwa so ɛfam,
na ɔmma m’animuonyam nyɛ fam.
6AWURADE, sɔre w’abufuo mu,
ma wo ho so tia m’ahohiahiafoɔ aniɛden,
na nyane ma me, wo a woahyɛ atemmuo.
7Na ma aman asafo ntwa wo ho nhyia,
na sane firi wɔn so kɔ soro.
8 # Dwom 18.20-26 AWURADE bɛbu aman atɛn;
AWURADE di m’asɛm sɛdeɛ me tenenee
ne bem a ɛwɔ me mu teɛ.
9 # Dwom 104.35; Yer 11.20; 17.10; Adi 2.23 Ao, ma abɔnefoɔ bɔne to ntwa ɛ!
Na ma ɔteneneeni ntim.
Na wone tenenee Nyankopɔn
a wosɔ akoma ne adwene hwɛ.
10 # Dwom 3.3 Me kyɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn nsam,
ɔno na ɔgye akoma mu teneneeni nkwa.
11 # Dwom 9.4 Onyankopɔn ne ɔtemmufoɔ tenenee,
ne Onyankopɔn a ɔteatea daa nyinaa.
12 # Deut 32.41; Kwa 2.4; 3.12 Sɛ obi annane n’akwan, Onyankopɔn bɛse n’afena,
wakuntunu ne tadua mu, na wasiesie.
13Na wasiesie owuo adeɛ ama onii korɔ no,
wayɛ n’agyan ma no hye adeɛ.
14Hwɛ, ɔmumuyɛfoɔ nyinsɛn amumuyɛ,
na ɔnyem ɛhaw,
na ɔwo atorɔ.
15 # Mmb 26.27 Watu amena, na wafunu mu,
na ɔtɔ tokuro a ɔno ara tuo no mu.
16Ne mmusuo resane abua n’atifi,
na n’amim aduru ne mpampam.
17Mɛda AWURADE ase sɛdeɛ ne tenenee teɛ,
na mato ayeyie dwom mama AWURADE a ɔwɔ sorosoro no din.

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn, wo na medwane bɛtoa wo.
Gye me m’atifoɔ nyinaa nsam, na yi me!
Na wɔansunsuane me kra sɛ gyata antete me mu
a ɔgyefoɔ nni hɔ.
AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, sɛ mayɛ yei,
na amumuyɛdeɛ bi wɔ me nsam,
sɛ mayɛ deɛ ɔne me te asomdwoeɛ mu bɔne
na madi deɛ ɔha me no amim bi kwa a,
ma ɔtamfoɔ ntaa me kra,
na ɔnkyere me, na ɔntiatia me nkwa so ɛfam,
na ɔmma m’animuonyam nyɛ fam.
AWURADE, sɔre w’abufuo mu,
ma wo ho so tia m’ahohiahiafoɔ aniɛden,
na nyane ma me, wo a woahyɛ atemmuo.
Na ma aman asafo ntwa wo ho nhyia,
na sane firi wɔn so kɔ soro.
AWURADE bɛbu aman atɛn;
AWURADE di m’asɛm sɛdeɛ me tenenee
ne bem a ɛwɔ me mu teɛ.
Ao, ma abɔnefoɔ bɔne to ntwa ɛ!
Na ma ɔteneneeni ntim.
Na wone tenenee Nyankopɔn
a wosɔ akoma ne adwene hwɛ.
Me kyɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn nsam,
ɔno na ɔgye akoma mu teneneeni nkwa.
Onyankopɔn ne ɔtemmufoɔ tenenee,
ne Onyankopɔn a ɔteatea daa nyinaa.
Sɛ obi annane n’akwan, Onyankopɔn bɛse n’afena,
wakuntunu ne tadua mu, na wasiesie.
Na wasiesie owuo adeɛ ama onii korɔ no,
wayɛ n’agyan ma no hye adeɛ.
Hwɛ, ɔmumuyɛfoɔ nyinsɛn amumuyɛ,
na ɔnyem ɛhaw,
na ɔwo atorɔ.
Watu amena, na wafunu mu,
na ɔtɔ tokuro a ɔno ara tuo no mu.
Ne mmusuo resane abua n’atifi,
na n’amim aduru ne mpampam.
Mɛda AWURADE ase sɛdeɛ ne tenenee teɛ,
na mato ayeyie dwom mama AWURADE a ɔwɔ sorosoro no din.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
